purpose: Complete two feature-removal checks requested in the early CAS feasibility audit but omitted from the primary CAS execution.

post_hoc_disclosure.reason_for_analysis: The early feasibility audit explicitly requested these checks, but no execution result or explicit cancellation record was found during the manuscript-methods audit on 2026-09-05.
post_hoc_disclosure.interpretation: Assess whether the direction and magnitude of the already reported CAS findings are sensitive to the two questioned feature sets; do not use the results to retune, select, or replace a model.

temporal_design.test_access_status: already inspected in the primary CAS analysis before this post-hoc protocol

scenarios.audit_origin: Remove urban and rerun the model as requested in the early CAS feasibility report.
Remove the two highly sparse speed fields together and rerun the model as requested in the early CAS feasibility report.

logistic_weighted.class_weight: frozen balanced weights computed from the complete 2022-2023 temporal training partition
logistic_weighted.categorical_preprocessing: training-only vocabulary plus __UNSEEN__, followed by one-hot encoding
logistic_weighted.numeric_preprocessing: training-median imputation with missing indicators, followed by training-fitted standardization

lightgbm_weighted.class_weight: the same frozen temporal balanced weights as the primary CAS model
lightgbm_weighted.categorical_preprocessing: LightGBM-native categorical values with training-only vocabulary plus __UNSEEN__
lightgbm_weighted.numeric_preprocessing: native numeric values with NaN retained

prediction_rule: argmax over Minor, Serious, and Fatal probabilities; no threshold adjustment

reporting.validation: Record 2024 point estimates for transparency only; do not use them to tune, select, or change the frozen settings.
reporting.test: Compare 2025 point estimates with the corresponding original 15-feature model on exactly the same records.

bootstrap.stratification: true severity class within the fixed 2025 temporal-test cohort
paired_comparisons: each ablated model minus its corresponding full 15-feature primary model
LightGBM minus Logistic within each ablation
bootstrap.interpretation_limit: Intervals represent record-level sampling uncertainty conditional on the fixed data, split, and fitting procedure; they do not erase the post-hoc status.

execution.output_policy: write only to models/cas_feature_ablation, results/cas_feature_ablation, logs/cas/cas_feature_ablation_*, and the completion record
